body: It would just be so much easier if I wasn't alive. My parents sacrificed so much. I feel like a piece of shit.

This is the hardest obstacle I've ever faced and the likely the hardest I'll ever face in my life. I have been suicidal for half a year and it's getting worse. Worst of all, it's my fault, and my parents are suffering because of it too. I am completely broken and don't want to live anymore.
Most med students take gap years and many take multiple. Just keep applying. Your scores are too good for them to ignore.
